Mon Jul 27 07:00 AM PT run. Live pass -- Google Ads and Yelp dashboards were both scraped this run; Yelp billing was accessible (no password wall).

TOAST (Sun Jul 26, group-level): net $7,599.05 / gross $8,037.30 / 310 guests / 190 orders / avg guest $24.51 / avg order $40.00 / labor 19.3% / discounts 5.5% / refunds $0 / 13 void items / 149 card payments. vs SDLW (Sun Jul 19): net -37.3%, gross -36.8%, guests -29.4%, orders -25.2%. A much quieter Sunday than the prior week, but Jul 19 was itself an unusually strong Sunday (net $12,115.62), so this looks like reversion to a normal baseline rather than a genuine falloff. One order left open at close; Katharine Brown auto-clocked out. The LOCATION-level email (labor $, void $, dayparts, rooms) had not landed at run time.

SLING (Mon Jul 27): 7 staff / 7 shifts / 24.75 hrs / 0 uncovered / 0 OT / 0 off -- the lightest weekday build seen in recent runs. TWO malformed zero-length entries persist -- Casey Smith (General Manager) 6:02A-6:02A and Rafael Patricio (Cook) 6:02A-6:02A -- both read as clock-in placeholders, not real shifts. Because Rafael's entry is malformed, there is no visible kitchen/cook coverage on the schedule today. Real coverage: Julianna Ornelas opens on coffee/bar (6:30A-12:30P), Christine Vargas covers bar 10:15A-3:30P, then the evening turns to Harmony Willson (bartender, 3:30P-9:30P), Osmar Beltran (server, 4:00P-8:30P) and Bea Southern (server, 5:00P-8:30P). There's a thin window between 12:30P and 3:30P with only Christine on the floor, and no confirmed kitchen coverage all day -- worth a manual double-check in Sling.

GOOGLE ADS (Jul 26, live): $56.31 / 6,157 impr / 138 clicks / CTR 2.24% / CPC $0.41 / 0 conversions (calculating). Only 2 of 4 campaigns served. PMax-2 carried 97% of impressions (5,966) and 121 clicks while flagged both 'Limited by budget' and all-asset-groups-policy-limited. BHC Coffee Search: 191 impr, 17 clicks, opt 44.4%. 'World Cup HQ 2026' ($20/day) is STILL PAUSED with 0 impressions, now over a week past the Final -- the highest-leverage stale item, archive it. 'Oldest SB Brewery on Tap' ($10.80/day) also paused, policy-limited. Ad Settings 'Estimated audience size' still reads 'Ideal.' Budget $13/day, 5-mile radius, $390/month max, est. 398 clicks/month. Yelp Inbox: 15 unread.
